label: Bible Study
prompt: O give _____ unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
verse: O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
note: A refrain that runs all through the Psalms and Chronicles — he is good; his mercy endures.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Fight the good fight of _____, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
verse: Fight the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.
note: Paul coaches young Timothy: fight the good fight of faith and lay hold on eternal life.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the LORD sent _____ serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verse: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
note: Fiery serpents in the camp — the crisis that led to Moses lifting up the brass serpent on a pole.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A false _____ is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
verse: A false balance is abomination to the LORD: but a just weight is his delight.
note: Rigged merchant scales were a common cheat; God calls them an abomination and honest weights his delight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are _____; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
verse: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
note: 'Temporal' means lasting only for a time — Paul's reason to fix your eyes on the unseen, which is eternal.
